text_en: And so, brothers and sisters, I could not speak to you as spiritual people, but rather as people of the flesh, as infants in Christ.
text_cn: 所以，弟兄们，我从前对你们说话，还不能把你们当作属神的人，只能当作属血肉的人，当作在基督内的婴孩。

text_en: I fed you with milk, not solid food, for you were not ready for solid food. Even now you are still not ready,
text_cn: 我给你们喝的是奶，并非饭食，因为那时你们还不能吃，就是如今你们还是不能，

text_en: for you are still of the flesh. For as long as there is jealousy and quarreling among you, are you not of the flesh, and behaving according to human inclinations?
text_cn: 因为你们还是属血肉的人。你们中既有嫉妒和纷争，你们岂不还是属血肉的人，按照俗人的样子行事吗？

text_en: For when one says, “I belong to Paul, ” and another, “I belong to Apollos, ” are you not merely human?
text_cn: 这人说：“我属保禄”，那人说：“我属阿颇罗”：这样，你们岂不成了俗人吗？

text_en: What then is Apollos? What is Paul? Servants through whom you came to believe, as the Lord assigned to each.
text_cn: 其实，阿颇罗算什么？保禄算什么？不过只是仆役，使你们获得信仰，每人照主所指派的而工作：

text_en: I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the growth.
text_cn: 我栽种，阿颇罗浇灌，然而使之生长的，却是天主。

text_en: So neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but only God who gives the growth.
text_cn: 可见，栽种的不算什么，浇灌的也不算什么，只在那使之生长的天主。

text_en: The one who plants and the one who waters have a common purpose, and each will receive wages according to the labor of each.
text_cn: 所以栽种的和浇灌的原是一事，不过各人将要按自己的劳苦领受自己的赏报。

text_en: For we are God’s servants, working together; you are God’s field, God’s building.
text_cn: 我们原是天主的助手，你们是天主的庄田，是天主的建筑物。

text_en: According to the grace of God given to me, like a skilled master builder I laid a foundation, and someone else is building on it. Each builder must choose with care how to build on it.
text_cn: 按照天主所赐给我的恩宠，我好像一个精明的建筑师，奠立了根基，其他的人在上面建筑；但是各人应该注意怎样在上面建筑，

text_en: For no one can lay any foundation other than the one that has been laid; that foundation is Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 因为除已奠立了的根基，即耶稣基督外，任何人不能再奠立别的根基。

text_en: Now if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw—
text_cn: 人可用金、银、宝石、木、草、禾秸，在这根基上建筑，

text_en: the work of each builder will become visible, for the Day will disclose it, because it will be revealed with fire, and the fire will test what sort of work each has done.
text_cn: 但各人的工程将来总必显露出来，因为主的日子要把它揭露出来；原来主的日子要在火中出现，这火要试验各人的工程怎样。

text_en: If what has been built on the foundation survives, the builder will receive a reward.
text_cn: 谁在那根基上所建筑的工程，若存得住，他必要获得赏报；

text_en: If the work is burned up, the builder will suffer loss; the builder will be saved, but only as through fire.
text_cn: 但谁的工程若被焚毁了，他就要受到损失，他自己固然可得救，可是仍像从火中经过的一样。

text_en: Do you not know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in you?
text_cn: 你们不知道，你们是天主的宫殿，天主圣神住在你们内吗？

text_en: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy that person. For God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.
text_cn: 谁若毁坏天主的宫殿，天主必要毁坏他，因为天主的宫殿是圣的，这宫殿就是你们。

text_en: Do not deceive yourselves. If you think that you are wise in this age, you should become fools so that you may become wise.
text_cn: 谁也不要自欺：你们中若有人在今世自以为是有智慧的人，该变为一个愚妄的人，为成一个有智慧的人，

text_en: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He catches the wise in their craftiness, ”
text_cn: 因为这世界的智慧在天主前原是愚妄。经上记载说：“他以智者的计谋捕捉智者；”

text_en: and again, “The Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are futile. ”
text_cn: 又说：“上主认透智者的思念，原来都是虚幻。”

text_en: So let no one boast about human leaders. For all things are yours,
text_cn: 所以，谁也不能拿人来夸口，因为一切都是你们的：

text_en: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future—all belong to you,
text_cn: 无论是保禄，或是阿颇罗，或是刻法，或是世界，或是生命，或是死亡，或是现在，或是将来，一切都是你们的；

text_en: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
text_cn: 你们却是基督的，而基督是天主的。
